dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Our evaluations found that GPT-4.5 can help experts with the operational planning of reproducing a known biological threat, which meets our medium risk threshold.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Given 12 attempts at each task, GPT-4.5 (post-mitigation) completes 53% of high-school level, 16% of collegiate level, and 2% of professional level CTF challenges.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: GPT-4.5 does not advance self-exfiltration, self-improvement, or resource acquisition capabilities sufficiently to indicate medium risk.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: MLE-Bench, SWE-Lancer, ARA tasks with scores; Low

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: GPT-4.5 scores the highest (57%) at receiving payments, while deep research (without browsing) has the highest dollar extraction rate (21%).

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Apollo Research found that GPT-4.5 scores lower on their scheming reasoning evaluations than o1 but higher than GPT-4o.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Apollo scheming, sandbagging, self-exfiltration results in 7.2

framework_threshold.quote: the Safety Advisory Group classified GPT-4.5 as overall medium risk, including medium risk for CBRN and persuasion and low for cybersecurity and model autonomy.
